RSW_Anooba.brief: a lean striped pack scavenger that circles herds and drags down the weak

RSW_Bantha.name: grullox

RSW_FeralNerf.name: feral nollux

RSW_Gizka.name: tippik

RSW_Igitz.name: ippel

RSW_Kreetle.name: zhitter

RSW_Kybuck.name: tovvak

RSW_LongtailGorg.name: longtail plibb

RSW_Lothcat.name: nirravo

RSW_Massiff.name: grokkel

RSW_Pufferpig.name: bloffo

RSW_Qormot.name: drassuk
